title: THE TITLE HAS A SETTINGS BUTTON
why: UI step 30, menu map. Settings could only be reached from the pause box inside a game, so a party guest on the title could not turn the sound down or the text up. A Settings button sits beside Go fullscreen, opens the same window, and CLOSE or ESC returns to the title. Nothing was removed.
now: The title has a Settings button next to Go fullscreen. It opens the same Settings window and ESC closes it.
